items.label: Init
items.content:
# Init Text Client

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey:'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model:'flux',
  stream:true,
  isImage:false,
  seed:12345,
  chatId:'t1'
});
```
- `stream:true` for live chunks
- `seed` ensures repeatable output

items.label: Config
items.content:
# Config Text Client

```javascript
client.config.systemPrompt='Helpful assistant';
client.clearHistory();
```
- `systemPrompt` sets AI persona
- `clearHistory()` resets past conversation

items.label: Stream
Generate
items.content:
# Generate Text

```javascript
await client.generate('Write a short motivational quote about AI.');
```
- Uses streaming if enabled
- Seed ensures repeatable output

items.label: Cleanup
items.content:
# Cleanup Text Client

- Auto cleanup removes `chatId` after generate/stream
- Manual: `client.destroy();`

items.label: Init
items.content:
# Init Image Client

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey:'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model:'flux',
  isImage:true,
  width:1024,
  height:1024,
  seed:12345,
  chatId:'i1'
});
```
- `seed` ensures repeatable images
- `width` & `height` define size

items.label: Config
Generate
items.content:
# Generate Image

```javascript
const blob = await client.generate('Futuristic city at sunset');
document.querySelector('#output-image').src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
```
- Auto cleanup removes `chatId`
- Seed ensures reproducibility

items.label: Cleanup
items.content:
# Cleanup Image Client

- Auto cleanup after generate
- Manual: `client.destroy();`
